newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets jump-started by New York.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets jump-started by New York.

text.p: European raw cotton markets were stung into action by a sudden upturn in New York futures and prices were up by between 0.50 and 2.00 cents, industry sources said.
The 'A' Index moved up 0.80 points to 77.05 after lingering around the 76.00 mark all week as buyers held off in expectation of a further weakening in prices.
Mill buyers began to re-enter the market with better quality cottons attracting the greatest interest.
Delays to shipments of Central Asian types have prompted some spinners to seek alternative origins, sources said.
